description: This file handles marking attendees and hosts as no-show in a booking system, including updating database records, sending webhooks, scheduling workflows, and performing audit logging.

classes.name: ResponsePayload
classes.description: A class to build and retrieve the response payload after marking no-shows, including attendees, host status, and message.

methods.name: buildResultPayload
methods.description: Builds the response message and attendee list after updating no-show status.

methods.name: logFailedResults
methods.description: Logs any failed promises during attendee updates.

methods.name: getBookingAttendeesFromEmails
methods.description: Fetches attendee records from the database based on booking UID and emails.

methods.name: fireNoShowUpdated
methods.description: Performs audit logging and triggers events after no-show status is updated.

methods.name: handleMarkNoShow
methods.description: Main function to handle marking attendees and/or host as no-show, including database updates, webhooks, workflows, and audit logs.

methods.name: updateAttendees
methods.description: Updates the no-show status of attendees in the database.

methods.name: getWebhooksService
methods.description: Initializes webhook service for booking events.

methods.name: assertCanAccessBooking
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to the booking and if the booking has started.
